Sanctification.md is mostly sound. A few borderline phrases risk implying outcomes as proof of salvation, but the cards and mirror correctly counter those errors. The note could sharpen its distinction between position and condition, yet the core doctrine is solid.

Discipleship.md is solid. It frames following Jesus as grateful obedience after faith, not as a way to buy eternal life.
